logp.method_description: The Hydrophobicity of the synthesised metal complexes 1-6 was determined toanalyse the penetration behaviour across the cell membrane. It is investigated in theterms of partition coefficient (log P) using the “shake flask” method betweenoctanol/water phase partitions. Because of the substitution variation in different complexes hydrophobicity differs. Octanol-saturated water (OSW) and water-saturated octanol (WSO) were prepared using analytical grade octanol (Sigma Aldrich) and doubly distilled water. Solubility and sample concentration plays an important role in the measurements of given compound of organic and aqueous medium. Partition coefficientin biphasic system were calculated by using the equation log P = log[(1-6)oct/(1-6)aq].6Complexes 1-6 (1 mg/mL; ethanol/water 1/6) were diluted to 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 μg/mL in water; alternatively these (1 mg/mL) were diluted to 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 μg/mL in octanol,respectively. Required quantities of the complexes (4 mg/mL) were shaken for one day at room temperature in equal volume (50/50). Once it achieved equilibrium, two phases were separated and centrifuged. As a final point, each phase drug concentration was measured by UV-visible spectroscopy.
